sections.purpose: To maintain controlled temperature conditions (typically 20°C or 37°C) for Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD) testing, microbiological incubation, and stability testing of pharmaceutical preparations.
sections.scope: Applicable to Pharmaceutics laboratory for microbial limit testing of pharmaceutical preparations and stability studies requiring controlled low-temperature incubation.
procedure: Connect the BOD incubator to a stable power supply and switch it ON.
Allow the incubator to equilibrate to the set temperature before placing samples inside.
Set the desired temperature using the digital controller: Standard BOD test requires 20°C ± 1°C; Microbiological tests may require 37°C.
Open the inner glass door carefully to place samples — minimize the time the door is open.
Arrange samples with adequate spacing to allow uniform airflow around all containers.
Record the incubation start time, temperature, and sample details in the logbook.
Monitor the temperature every 24 hours and log the readings.
Do not open the incubator unnecessarily — each opening disturbs the equilibrium.
At the end of the incubation period, remove samples promptly and proceed with analysis.
After use, clean the inner surfaces with a suitable disinfectant (70% ethanol) and allow to dry before closing.
Switch off the incubator if not in use for extended periods.
Document all temperature records and sample details in the equipment logbook.
precautions: Do not overload the incubator — overcrowding prevents proper air circulation and temperature uniformity.
Ensure the temperature controller and alarm systems are calibrated regularly.
Place a calibrated thermometer inside as an independent temperature check.
Do not store volatile or flammable chemicals in the incubator — the internal fan can generate sparks.
Clean spills immediately to prevent contamination and corrosion.
Ensure the incubator is levelled properly for uniform temperature distribution.
Place the incubator away from direct sunlight, heat sources, and drafts.
Keep the door gasket clean and in good condition — worn gaskets cause temperature fluctuation.
